title: Reset password
steps: User enters and confirms new password
System updates password and confirms success

title: Enroll in a module
steps: User navigates to the module catalogue
System displays module details and enrol option
System confirms enrolment and updates user account
System shows the module on the user's dashboard

title: Submit coursework assignment
steps: System displays assessment list and deadlines
System displays assignment brief and upload area
System validates file type/size and checks deadline
System confirms submission and records timestamp

title: Attempt quiz and view results
steps: System displays quiz instructions and 'Start quiz'
User answers questions and navigates through the quiz
System marks answers and calculates score
